import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT=Path('/Users/yuxianqi/Project/qlib')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_harness import _baseline
from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
PARENT=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1'
PREV=PARENT/'extensions/forward-spread-20261112'
WEEK=PREV/'stages/weekly-h5'
BASE=PARENT/'extensions/weekly-h5-four-20261113'
CLASS=BASE/'classifier'
OLDCLASS=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/model-structure/style-classifier-k4-20261108-v1'
PROVIDER=ROOT/'backtest/result/20261103_h20_causal_inputs/evaluation-provider'
CAL=PROVIDER/'calendars/day.txt'
SEEDS=[42,1000,2000,3000,4000]
NAMES=['D','F','T','P']
ARMS=['lgb_full','lgb_core','logistic_full']
ST=BASE/'docs/stage-state.json'
CONTRACT=BASE/'configs/contract.json'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def write(p,x):
    p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
    q=p.with_name('.'+p.name+str(os.getpid())+'.tmp')
    q.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    q.replace(p)
def fp(p):
    p=Path(p).resolve()
    with p.open('rb') as f:h=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
    return {'path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) if p.is_relative_to(ROOT) else str(p),'sha256':h,'size':p.stat().st_size}
def dg(x):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def checked():
    d=read(ST);old=d.pop('checksum')
    assert dg(d)==old and d['contract']==fp(CONTRACT)
    assert d['baseline_digest']==dg(_baseline(ROOT,'all_a_model'))
    return d
def update(d):
    d.pop('checksum',None)
    d['checksum']=dg(d);write(ST,d)
def init():
    assert not ST.exists() and not CONTRACT.exists()
    r=read(PREV/'docs/final-verification.json')
    assert r['verified'] and r['expert_successes']==60 and read(PREV/'docs/stage-state.json')['status']=='closed'
    b=_baseline(ROOT,'all_a_model');assert b['exp_id']=='training-target/h20-quantile10-p50-v5'
    row=next(x for x in reversed(load_registry(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/registry.jsonl')) if x['exp_id']=='train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1')
    assert row['state']=='completed' and row['stage_id']==PREV.name
    baseline=BASE/'docs/original-parent-record.json'
    if baseline.exists():assert read(baseline)==row
    else:write(baseline,row)
    paths=[ROOT/'AGENTS.md',ROOT/'backtest/EXPERIMENT_STANDARD.md',ROOT/'docs/research/experiment_harness.md',PARENT/'docs/harness-state.json',OLDCLASS/'docs/style-harness-state.json',PREV/'docs/stage-state.json',PREV/'docs/expert-state.json',PREV/'docs/partition-verification.json',WEEK/'data/date-labels.csv',WEEK/'data/period-labels.csv',WEEK/'data/label-model.joblib',WEEK/'docs/label-fit.json',PREV/'data/quotes/forward.parquet',PREV/'data/quotes/effective-quotes.npz',OLDCLASS/'data/features.parquet',OLDCLASS/'configs/feature-manifest.json',OLDCLASS/'data/daily-market.parquet',CAL,ROOT/b['model_manifest'],ROOT/'backtest/market_style/modeling.py',ROOT/'backtest/market_style/evaluation.py']
    for folder in [BASE/'configs',BASE/'docs',BASE/'data',BASE/'reports',CLASS/'configs',CLASS/'docs',CLASS/'data',CLASS/'models',CLASS/'metrics',CLASS/'reports',CLASS/'source-records']:folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    contract={'id':BASE.name,'stage_id':BASE.name,'parent_exp_id':row['exp_id'],'track':'all_a_model + market-level four-class research','user_scope':'固定周度H5；个股训练标签改H5；D/F/T/P单列；预测下一交易日的周风格。','baseline_ref':b['exp_id'],'seeds':SEEDS,'classes':NAMES,'partition':'frozen weekly-h5 style4; no reclustering, no smoothing, six sessions from last weekly signal to realization','train_window':['2004-01-02','2020-07-31'],'evaluation_window':['2020-08-03','2026-07-31'],'stock_signal_end':'2026-07-23','classifier_signal_end':'2026-07-30','prior_cost':{'stock_starts':139,'stock_successes':135,'classification_fits':40,'label_kmeans_starts':8,'label_kmeans_successes':7},'inputs':[fp(x) for x in paths],
    'stock':{'candidate_styles':NAMES,'matched_control':'ALL_H5','target':'raw adjusted close(t+6)/close(t+1)-1; v5 old per-day equal-count deciles fixed affine encoding using actual H5 eligible universe','training_boundary':'include only original allowed training dates, H5 target exit and frozen weekly style ready_date <=2020-07-31; matched H5 control is exact union of style rows','features_weights_params':'original 164 features, M0 weights and v5 hyperparameters including 200 max rounds, patience50. Top5×H5 net_ann on own style dates (ALL across dates) with complete 1448-session turnover context.','evaluation':'unchanged official Top3×H5 daily cross-section zscore 5-seed blend and H5 RankIC; own-style versus frozen v5 main, matched H5 reference and prior H20 experts re-scored on original 4 labels diagnostic; money figures annualized within style, no automatic promotion','criterion':'strict positive same-date delta on both net_ann and net_sharpe for each style. RankIC, paired seeds, period robustness, uncertainty of five P weeks separately.','representative_candidate':'ALL_H5 full-period, administrative only'},
    'representative_candidate':'ALL_H5 full-period','classifier':{'arms':ARMS,'primary':'lgb_full','features':'Frozen 361 historical features available at t close plus as-of weekly market path, lagged end-of-holding returns available by t, last matured weekly factors, and already observable partial fixed-basket returns; no unconfirmed labels. Core=26 historical compact variables plus new weekly observations.','target':'features at t close, actual next trading day u; y=raw weekly style4 at u; first/last signal and target dates both inside split. Training only with weekly ready_date <=2020-07-31.','asof':'Date-only bars at close; no external data with unverified publication timestamps; no use of future outcome or intervening last-week label as feature before ready_date.','recipe':'Existing LGBM multiclass depth5/15 leaves, sqrt_inverse class frequencies calculated in train; 1000 round cap, multi_logloss early stopping patience50 on historical eval directly; one prefix at 50 rounds of the same trajectory with no eval-selected iterations as sensitivity. Logistic as frozen linear comparator, original C=0.1, median/scale learned in train, five seeds. All five probability vectors arithmetic averaged in D,F,T,P order; argmax, no threshold tuning or model choice based on test.','controls':['training-prior and majority','persistence of most recently fully matured weekly label available on signal date'], 'evaluation':['daily accuracy/macro-F1/balanced accuracy/logloss/Brier/confusion/precision/recall/F1 each class','first tradable target of each week vs later targets','within-eval maturity sensitivity and P event hits','bootstrap by contiguous blocks of 8 weeks'], 'data_version_classifier':'historical frozen 2026-11-06 source stock panel, effective quote panel through 2026-09-30 used only per as-of available endpoints, same historical inputs as frozen weekly H5'},
    'budget':{'new_kmeans':0,'stock_scientific_fits':25,'stock_max_starts':29,'classification_scientific_fits':15,'classification_max_starts':18,'wall_hours':18,'one_expensive_stock_fit_at_a_time':True},'status_backend':'Both original native protocols are closed. The native classifier only supports monthly-k4-next-day-v1 and matching inner receipts. This bounded supplement owns weekly no-inner classifier starts in docs/stage-state.json and stock starts in experts/docs/expert-state.json under one parent.','limitations':['Evaluation also used for early stopping; historical selection study.','Economic cluster naming reference uses historical full series. Expert H5 maturity, member eligibility and own-style ES differ from original v5; H5 full control and H20 old expert bridge reported.','P concentrated in few weeks, report raw counts and leave-week sensitivity.','Classifier date target and stock signal dates have distinct roles and coverage.']}
    write(CONTRACT,contract)
    d={'schema':'weekly-h5-four-20261113-v1','status':'active','started_at':now(),'deadline_epoch':__import__('time').time()+18*3600,'contract':fp(CONTRACT),'baseline_digest':dg(b),'prior_cost':contract['prior_cost'],'classifier_jobs':{},'events':[]}
    update(d)
def event(kind,**kwargs):
    with (BASE/'docs/stage-state.lock').open('a+') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX); d=checked();assert d['status']=='active'
        j=d['classifier_jobs']
        if kind=='fit_start':
            assert __import__('time').time()<d['deadline_epoch']
            assert len(j)<18 and not any(x['state']=='running' for x in j.values())
            arm,seed=kwargs['arm'],kwargs['seed']
            assert arm in ARMS and seed in SEEDS
            prior=[x for x in j.values() if (x['arm'],x['seed'])==(arm,seed)]
            assert not prior or all(x['state']=='failed' for x in prior)
            job=f'{arm}-{seed}-a{1+len(prior)}';j[job]={**kwargs,'started_at':now(),'state':'running'}
        elif kind=='fit_result':
            job=kwargs['job'];assert j[job]['state']=='running' and kwargs['state'] in ['completed','failed']
            j[job].update(**kwargs,finished_at=now())
        elif kind=='close':
            assert len([x for x in j.values() if x['state']=='completed'])==15
            assert read(BASE/'docs/cleanup.json')['temporary']=='cleaned'
            d['status']='closed';job=None
        else:job=None
        d['events'].append({'kind':kind,'job':job,'at':now(),**kwargs});update(d)
        return job
if __name__=='__main__':init()
